note: CacheFlush builds cache-clearing PRESETS (the `cacheflush` content entity, base table `cacheflush`, provided by cacheflush_entity). Service/controller cacheflush.api (CacheflushApi) does clearAll (drupal_flush_all_caches), clearById/clearPresetCache (run a preset's stored #name/#params functions), clearBinCache, clearStorageCache('twig'), clearModuleCache, clearCacheTags. Ready routes /admin/cacheflush/clear/all and /admin/cacheflush/clear/{cacheflush}, permission 'cacheflush clear cache'. Option catalog = cache bins + hook_cacheflush_tabs_options (base adds static/asset/kernel/twig/plugin/module/router). A preset row has title/status/data(serialized). Medium cases inspect real preset rows; hard cases build a published preset whose serialized data clears a specific target (render bin / twig storage), verified via SQL on the cacheflush table (no rendering).

evals.prompt: With the cacheflush module, what is the ready-made way to flush ALL Drupal caches, and which permission controls it?
evals.expected_output: Visit /admin/cacheflush/clear/all (route cacheflush.presets.clearall, controller CacheflushApi::clearAll which calls drupal_flush_all_caches()). It is gated by the 'cacheflush clear cache' permission.

evals.prompt: In the cacheflush module, what is a 'preset' and how does clearing one work?
evals.expected_output: A preset is a `cacheflush` content entity whose `data` field stores the selected cache-clear options as callable #name/#params function definitions. Clearing it (CacheflushApi::clearById/clearPresetCache) runs those functions in order; a disabled preset (status 0) is refused with a 403.

evals.prompt: Which service does cacheflush expose for clearing caches programmatically, and how can another module add its own clearable option to cacheflush presets?
evals.expected_output: The service is cacheflush.api (Drupal\cacheflush\Controller\CacheflushApi) with methods like clearBinCache(), clearStorageCache(), clearModuleCache(), clearCacheTags(). Other modules add clearable options by implementing hook_cacheflush_tabs_options() (returning option ids with category + #name/#params functions).

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a cacheflush preset configured. Inspect the cacheflush entities/table and give the title of the preset that exists.
evals.expected_output: A published `cacheflush` preset titled 'cf_known' exists (it clears the render cache). Found via e.g. `drush sqlq "SELECT title, status FROM cacheflush"`.

evals.prompt: This site has two cacheflush presets, cf_on and cf_off. Exactly one is enabled (published). Inspect the live cacheflush entities and state which preset is enabled.
evals.expected_output: cf_on is enabled (status = 1); cf_off has status = 0. A disabled preset cannot be cleared (403). Read via `drush sqlq "SELECT title, status FROM cacheflush"`.

evals.prompt: Using the cacheflush module, create a published cache-flush preset named exactly 'cf_task' that clears the render cache (the render cache bin) when run. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A `cacheflush` entity titled 'cf_task' with status=1 whose data selects the render bin (its functions call CacheflushApi::clearBinCache with 'cache.render'), e.g. created via the /admin/structure/cacheflush/add form (Core cache tables → render) or the entity API.

evals.prompt: Create a published cacheflush preset named 'cf_task_twig' that wipes the Twig PHP storage cache (the module's 'twig' option) when executed, and save it on this site.
evals.expected_output: A `cacheflush` entity titled 'cf_task_twig' with status=1 whose data includes the 'twig' option (CacheflushApi::clearStorageCache('twig')), created via the preset form ('Other core cache options' → Twig) or the entity API.
